question.problem:
Anna decides to go jogging. Her position from the starting point, measured in meters, is given by the function $s(t),$ where $t$ is the time in seconds. The values of $s(t)$ for different values of $t$ are given in the table below:

| **$t$** | $1$ | $3$ | $5$ | $7$ | $9$ | $11$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $s(t)$ | $1$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ | $14$ | $25$ |

$$

$$

Approximate the velocity ${s}^{′}(t)$ at the point $t=7$ using a central difference approximation with the step size $h=2.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the central difference approximation

$$
{s}^{′}(t)≈\frac{s(t+h)-s(t-h)}{2h},
$$

 
at the time $t=7$ with step size $h=2.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{s}^{′}(7) & ≈\frac{s(7+2)-s(7-2)}{2(2)} \\  & =\frac{s(9)-s(5)}{2(2)} \\  & =\frac{14-4}{4} \\  & =\frac{10}{4} \\  & =2.5.\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the velocity of Anna at the instant of time $t=7$ is $2.5\,\text{m}/\text{s}.$
